name: palmyra

scripts.build: node scripts/write-version.mjs && vite build && node scripts/build-web-bundle.mjs && esbuild server.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --packages=external --sourcemap --outfile=dist/server.cjs
scripts.clean: node -e "const fs=require('fs');for(const dir of ['dist','dist-admin','dist-desktop'])fs.rmSync(dir,{recursive:true,force:true});for(const file of fs.readdirSync('.'))if(file.endsWith('.tsbuildinfo'))fs.rmSync(file,{force:true})"
scripts.desktop:dist: npm run build:desktop && electron-builder --win nsis --publish never
scripts.build:desktop: npm run build && esbuild server.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --external:sharp --external:vite --outfile=dist/desktop-server.cjs && esbuild main.electron.cjs --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --target=node20 --external:electron --external:sharp --external:vite --outfile=dist/desktop-main.cjs && esbuild src/desktop/mainRuntime.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --external:sharp --outfile=dist/desktop-runtime.cjs

description: PALMYRA POS · CRM y punto de venta offline-first
author: PALMYRA
